title: Shrinkage Allowance on FBN Warehouse-Loss Approvals
content:
**Standard.** On a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss approval, the shrinkage allowance is waived (0 units) for an enrollment in FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program whose seller stands at Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level; for an enrollment in FBN Core Program, FBN Growth Program or FBN Scale Program whose seller stands at Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level it is the per-incident allowance of 1 unit times the number of lost-in-warehouse inventory adjustments of the case's SKU dated inside the desk review span of 6 months. For every other enrollment the allowance is not altered by this standard.

The seller's standing is the level on the Seller Performance Standing record. An adjustment is dated inside the 6-month desk review span when fewer than 6 whole months have passed from its date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month.

## Program and level combined

| Program | Below Standard, Developing Seller or Standard Level | Above Standard Level | Top Rated or Preferred Partner Level |
|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | not altered | not altered | not altered |
| FBN Core Program | not altered | 1 unit per adjustment | 1 unit per adjustment |
| FBN Growth Program | not altered | 1 unit per adjustment | 1 unit per adjustment |
| FBN Scale Program | not altered | 1 unit per adjustment | 1 unit per adjustment |
| FBN Premier Program | not altered | not altered | waived, 0 units |
| FBN Enterprise Program | not altered | not altered | waived, 0 units |

Both parts of each condition — the program and the level — must hold together.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- FBN Scale Program, Top Rated Level, three lost-in-warehouse adjustments of the SKU in the last 6 whole months and one older: allowance of 3 units.
- FBN Enterprise Program, Preferred Partner Level: allowance of 0 units whatever the adjustments.
- FBN Premier Program, Above Standard Level: not altered by this standard.
